dict.string: NotchDeck reads and controls what is playing in Music and Spotify, and toggles Dark Mode.
NotchDeck announces Bluetooth devices such as AirPods when they connect.
NotchDeck shows today's and tomorrow's events in the notch and reminds you before they start.

The Mirror tab shows your front camera so you can check yourself before a call.
NotchDeck shows download progress in the notch and can add finished downloads to the tray.
The Desk tab shows your open reminders, lets you tick them off and add new ones, and alerts you when one is due.
